---
title: Quarto figure aspect ratio
format: html
jupyter: python3
---

```{python}
#| label: fig-light-on
#| fig-cap: Two plots
#| fig-subcap:
#|   - Increasing
#|   - Decreasing
#| layout-ncol: 2
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

for values in ([0, 1, 2], [2, 1, 0]):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.4, 4.8))
    ax.plot(values)
    plt.show()
```
